caption_L2L3: Between 2004 and 2018 the spend on advertising via transport / outdoor has increased from $19m to $39m,  increase of $20m or 105%. It has been a year-on-year increase of around $1m to $3m, other than in 2009 and 2010 when it dropped to and was held at $20m. The value spend then recovered and continued to increase annually, as before.
